title: Team Flow Metrics and Insights

label: For "Team Flow Metrics and Insights": Show team-level flow metrics such as lead time, deployment frequency and change failure rate with explanations of what moved, to support team improvement and never to rank people. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Individual metrics.
